get.description: Reports whether the API process is running and serving requests.
Searches TMDb by title, stores the results in the NextMovie catalogue, and returns them ranked by relevance.
Returns a film from the NextMovie catalogue, enriching it from TMDb when its details are missing or stale.

post.description: Creates a new account with an email and password, and returns an access token and refresh token for the new session.
Exchanges an email and password for an access token and refresh token. Repeated failures temporarily lock the account.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. The presented token is revoked; presenting it again ends the session.
Revokes the session the refresh token belongs to. Always succeeds, whether or not the token was still valid.
Verifies a Google ID token and returns a NextMovie session, creating an account or linking the Google identity to an existing one.

get.description: Returns the profile of the account the access token belongs to.

put.description: Replaces the editable parts of the profile. Fields omitted from the request are cleared.
Records the signed-in user's rating of a film, on a 0.5–5.0 half-star scale. Rating a film also records that it was watched.

delete.description: Removes the signed-in user's rating of a film. The film stays in their watch history.

get.summary: Get your rating of a film
get.description: Returns the signed-in user's rating of a film, if they have rated it.
Returns rated films, most recently rated first.
Returns films the signed-in user has not seen, ranked against their viewing and rating history, each with the reasons behind its ranking.

post.description: Accepts a Letterboxd CSV export (watched, ratings or diary), parses it, and queues it for matching against TMDb. Returns a job to poll.

get.description: Reports the status and progress of a Letterboxd import.
Returns the rows of an import that could not be resolved confidently, with the films they might mean.

post.summary: Choose the film an import row meant
post.description: Applies the row's rating and viewing to the chosen film, as a confident match would have done during the import.
Marks a row as deliberately not imported — a television series, or a film the user does not want.

email.description: Email address, as the user entered it.

displayName.description: Name to show in the UI.

profileImageUrl.description: Avatar URL, when one is set.

AuthenticatedUser.description: The account a session belongs to.

accessToken.description: Bearer token for API calls. Send as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: When the access token stops being accepted.

refreshToken.description: Opaque token used to obtain a new access token. Store it as securely as a password.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: When the refresh token stops being exchangeable.

status.description: Always `healthy` when the process is serving requests.

version.description: Informational assembly version of the running build.

timestampUtc.description: Server time at which the probe was answered.

HealthResponse.description: Response body returned by the health endpoint.

movieId.description: NextMovie identifier, to send back when choosing.

averageRating.description: TMDb community rating, which is usually what distinguishes these.

ImportCandidate.description: A film an ambiguous row might mean.

totalItems.description: Rows parsed out of the export.

matchedItems.description: Rows resolved to a film and applied.

ambiguousItems.description: Rows needing a person to choose between candidates.

unresolvedItems.description: Rows nothing plausible was found for.

skippedRows.description: Rows in the file that carried no title and could not be matched.

failureReason.description: Why the import failed, when it did.

completedAt.description: When the import finished, if it has.

itemId.description: The row, to resolve or dismiss.

name.description: Title exactly as the export gave it.

year.description: Year the export gave, when it gave one.

rating.description: The rating waiting to be applied, if the export carried one.

watchedOn.description: The viewing date from the export, when it had one.

status.description:
`Ambiguous` when several films were plausible, `Unresolved` when
none were — which often means the row is television rather than a film.

candidates.description: The films this row might mean. Empty when nothing was found.

ImportReviewItem.description: One row a person has to decide about.

email.description: Email address the account was registered with. Case-insensitive.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token held by the client signing out.

tmdbId.description: TMDb identifier, exposed for attribution and deep links.

originalTitle.description: Title in the original language, when it differs.

posterPath.description: Relative TMDb poster path; combine with a TMDb image base URL to render.

runtime.description: Runtime in minutes. Null when TMDb does not know it.

averageRating.description: TMDb community rating 0–10. Null when the film has no votes.

popularity.description: TMDb popularity score. Only meaningful compared against other films.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the original language.

watch.description:
Where the signed-in viewer can watch it. Empty and `known: false` for
anonymous visitors, since availability depends on who is asking.

MovieDetails.description: Everything the catalogue holds about a film.

ratedAt.description: When the rating was last set or changed.

MovieRating.description: The signed-in user's rating of a film.

id.description: NextMovie identifier. Stable, and the one clients should store.

tmdbId.description: TMDb identifier, exposed for attribution and deep links.

posterPath.description: Relative TMDb poster path; combine with a TMDb image base URL to render.

averageRating.description: TMDb community rating 0–10. Null when the film has no votes.

ratings.description: Rated films, most recently rated first.

MyRatingsResponse.description: A page of the user's ratings.

ratedAt.description: When the rating was last set or changed.

RatedMovie.description: A film the user has rated.

recommendations.description:
Ranked, best first. Empty when there is not enough history to reason from —
which is an honest answer rather than a fallback to whatever is popular.

rank.description:
Position in this response, from 1. Deliberately not a match percentage: the
scores behind a list sit within a few points of each other, and publishing
them would suggest a precision the model does not have.

confidence.description:
`High`, `Medium` or `Low` — how much history stands behind the
judgement, including whether this person has watched anything in the film's
genres.

reasons.description:
Why it ranked where it did, drawn from the factors that actually moved it.
Possibly empty; never invented.

watch.description: Where the viewer can watch it, in their region.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token issued by register, login, or a previous refresh.

email.description: Email address. Must be unique, ignoring case.

displayName.description: Name to show in the UI.

password.description: Chosen password. See PasswordPolicy for the rules.

RegisterUserRequest.description: Details needed to create an account.

movieId.description: NextMovie identifier of the chosen film.

ResolveImportItemRequest.description: The film an import row meant.

totalPages.description: Total pages available for this query.

results.description: Films on this page, ordered by relevance.

idToken.description: An ID token obtained by the client from Google.

SignInWithGoogleRequest.description: The Google ID token to sign in with.

displayName.description: Name to show in the UI. Required.

profileImageUrl.description: Absolute http or https avatar URL. Omit or send null to clear it.

UpdateCurrentUserRequest.description: The new state of the editable profile.

email.description: Email address, as the user entered it.

profileImageUrl.description: Avatar URL, when one is set.

streamingOn.description: Services the user subscribes to that carry it. Press play.

streamingElsewhere.description: Services carrying it that the user has not said they have.

rentOrBuy.description: Services offering it for money on top. Never described as streaming.

canStreamNow.description: Whether it can be watched without paying again.

known.description:
Whether availability has been looked up. False means unknown rather than
unavailable, and clients must say so — TMDb's provider data is not exhaustive,
and "we do not know" is not "it is nowhere".

link.description: Where to send the viewer, when the source suggests somewhere.

WatchingOptions.description: Where a film can be watched, for the person asking.
